default_in_force_rule.text: Interpretation Act (Cap. 01:04): an enactment comes into operation on the date of its publication in the Gazette unless it provides otherwise; amending Acts here name their own commencement ("Date of Commencement" in the e-Laws bulletin), which is used as given.

country.licence_note: Botswana e-Laws: "Copyright (c) 2026. All right reserved. Government of Botswana." Text read from the publisher's open Constitution page and from Internet Archive captures of its earlier site (botswanalaws.com). Whether Botswana excludes legislative texts from copyright is not verified; this repository is private.

decisions: Botswana e-Laws (e-laws.botswanalaws.com) is the official consolidation; only its Constitution page is open. Every other act is members-only and was never read or worked around; earlier full texts come only from Internet Archive captures of the publisher's previous site (botswanalaws.com) in which the members-only tag leaked.

Text normalisation: hidden <input> notes, tags and footnote markers dropped; NBSP to space; curly quotes to straight; en and em dashes to "-"; runs of spaces collapsed. e-Laws amendment notes ("[1 of 2021, s. 2(a).]") are not text: they are read for credits only. The closing e-Laws editorial note on Act 9 of 2005's word substitutions is not part of any unit.
Units: one file per section (s-NNN, s-051-a, s-020-to-029 for the repealed range) and per schedule (schedule-N). Chapter and part headings are not units.
ai_use: Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote fetch.py and parse.py and chose the sources. No model wrote or altered legal text, and no model runs at build time.
